patterns.description: A significant number of customers report dissatisfaction with the food quality, indicating issues with taste, preparation, or consistency.
Several reviews highlight negative experiences with staff attitude, including unfriendliness, lack of attentiveness, or poor service.
Customers frequently express concerns about the pricing, finding it too high or not commensurate with the value received.
Multiple reviews mention a negative or unappealing ambience, impacting the overall dining experience.
Customers frequently report issues with long wait times for seating or service.
Several reviews point to various unspecified negative issues, categorized as 'other', suggesting general dissatisfaction beyond specific aspects.
A few customers expressed concerns regarding the cleanliness of the establishment.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of customers report dissatisfaction with the food quality, indicating issues with taste, preparation, or consistency.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent cooking standards, poor ingredient quality, or lack of attention to detail in food preparation.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews highlight negative experiences with staff attitude, including unfriendliness, lack of attentiveness, or poor service.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training in customer service, low staff morale, or understaffing leading to stress.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently express concerns about the pricing, finding it too high or not commensurate with the value received.
root_causes.cause: Misalignment between perceived value and price, or pricing strategy not competitive with similar establishments.

root_causes.pattern: Multiple reviews mention a negative or unappealing ambience, impacting the overall dining experience.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or lack of maintenance.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report issues with long wait times for seating or service.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours, inefficient order processing, or poor table management.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews point to various unspecified negative issues, categorized as 'other', suggesting general dissatisfaction beyond specific aspects.
root_causes.cause: A combination of minor issues, or a general decline in overall service/experience not fitting into specific categories. Could also indicate a lack of attention to detail in various operational areas.

root_causes.pattern: A few customers expressed concerns regarding the cleanliness of the establishment.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient cleaning staff, or lack of regular maintenance checks.
